newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork beats year high after contract award.
newsitem.headline: Stork beats year high after contract award.

text.p: Shares in Dutch industrial group Stork NV hit new year highs on Wednesday after the company was awarded a near one billion guilder contract to carry out renovations at a major Dutch gasfield.
Stork shares stood up 2.20 guilders at 57.80 at 1320 GMT, above their previous peak at 57.20 guilders set on Nov 15.
"I think it is a very good deal for Stork and I think the shares could well go up even further," an Amsterdam dealer said.
Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij, a 50-50 joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon, said on Wednesday Stork would renovate its (northern Dutch) Slochteren gasfield.
"The contract between NAM and Stork is worth over one billion guilders," NAM said. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
